focus_areas: Anatomical correctness of the baby's hands and fingers (fusion check).
3D volume and separation of the diaper padding from the body (melting check).
Sharpness of the diaper's elastic ruffles against the skin.
Legibility and nature of the overlay text.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the baby's fingers and the bottle neck; ensure there is no melting or fusion using the depth map. Verify that the diaper's volume is physically distinct from the baby's legs. Check if the watermark text is standard stock photography branding or AI hallucination. Confirm that the absence of adhesive tabs is due to the viewing angle and not a generation error.
image_description: A portrait of a smiling baby sitting on a pink surface, holding a white bottle. The baby is wearing a white diaper with visible elastic ruffles at the leg openings. A large semi-transparent watermark overlays the center of the image.
